caption_lines: Yeh adaayein kahan se laati ho?
Main har baar phas jaata hoon.
slides.beat: Zuv catches Aachu doing a playful mirror glance while pretending she is only fixing her earring.
slides.emotional_job: Make the viewer feel the helpless admiration inside his complaint.

slides.beat: Aachu fixes Zuv's already-perfect collar just to keep him at the doorway.
slides.emotional_job: Make the fake excuse instantly recognizable and sendable.

slides.beat: After a small fight, Aachu looks away but still places water or pulls a blanket near Zuv.
slides.emotional_job: Show complaints and care living in the same hand gesture.

slides.beat: On the terrace at night, Aachu rests her head on Zuv's shoulder and he freezes mid-gesture, smiling because he has lost.
slides.emotional_job: Land the surrender: he has no defense against her softness.
